names: P11A -- traffic median (half-circle island near Mission Bay Circle)
summary: A grass, semicircular traffic median immediately east of the 'Mission Bay Circle' roundabout, west of the P12 soccer field (labeled 'SFF Soccer + Fitness Court' in OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update); per this repository's own satellite trace (no outside source describes the median), an already-landscaped median island, hand-traced with the property owner's guidance and fit to an idealized semicircle. OCII's own September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P11/11A' together among the parcels SF Recreation and Parks will manage (not among the 'when built' parcels), consistent with it being complete by that date.

milestones.text: Listed as 'P11/11A' among the parcels RPD will manage (not among the 'when built' parcels) in OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation -- an upper bound on when this median was built, not its actual construction date

images.appeal_note: A straight-down orthophoto rather than an oblique aerial, but Oracle Park and Chase Center are both clearly recognizable landmarks in the frame, giving anyone who knows the city an immediate fix on the neighborhood.

open_questions: No public source names this specific median island or gives its own construction date; the Sept 2023 OCII document only establishes it existed and was already RPD-managed by that date (grouped with P11), which is an upper bound, not a build date.

This record was previously only a weak ~33m proximity guess with no real source before the property owner drew its actual outline directly on a satellite screenshot (per this record's own digitization_method log); the P-number itself, and any name/operator, remain unconfirmed by any independent published source.
